subject: Music Production
title: Turntablism and Live Sampling
description: A short lesson to help you apply Turntablism and Live Sampling.

hook.text: DJs discovered they could use turntables as musical instruments by manipulating vinyl records live.

buildup.text: Scratching, beat juggling, and looping vinyl breaks turned DJing into a real-time sampling performance.

discovery.text: Grandmaster Flash invented the quick mix theory, seamlessly blending breakbeats from multiple records.

twist.text: A turntable designed only for playback became one of hip-hop's most expressive creative instruments.

climax.text: Turntablism proved that sampling was not just a studio technique—it was a live art form.

punchline.text: A playback device became an instrument in itself.

quiz.question: What did Grandmaster Flash's quick mix theory involve?
options: Seamlessly blending breakbeats from multiple vinyl records
